products.name: deploy-arch-ibm-redhat-ai-inference
products.label: Cloud automation for Red Hat AI Inference
products.short_description: Creates and configures a Red Hat AI Inference project on IBM Cloud
products.long_description:
A Red Hat AI Inference (RHAII) project is an instance of the `instructlab` service in IBM Cloud. The project gives you a dedicated endpoint for the Red Hat AI Inference API, which serves OpenAI compatible chat completion, completion, embedding and rerank requests on the models that are available in the project. This deployable architecture creates a project in an existing resource group, or reads an existing project by its ID or CRN. It can also check that the inference models your application needs are available in the project, and it returns the public and private endpoints of the project.  

The service is available only in the `us-east` region and on the `instructlab-pricing-plan` plan today.  

You can access the [source code and documentation](https://github.com/terraform-ibm-modules/terraform-ibm-redhat-ai-inference) of the underlying Terraform IBM Module and use it to extend your current architecture or create new solutions.

features.title: Red Hat AI Inference project
features.description: Creates a Red Hat AI Inference project with a dedicated endpoint for the Red Hat AI Inference API, or reads an existing project by its ID (GUID) or CRN. [Learn more](https://cloud.ibm.com/docs/inference).

features.title: Inference model checks
features.description: Optionally lists the inference models that are available in the project, and fails the plan early when a model that your application needs is not available.

features.title: Public and private endpoints
features.description: Returns the public and private base URLs of the API, so that you can pass them to applications, for example a Code Engine app.

features.title: Tagging
features.description: Adds user tags and access management tags to a new project. The access management tags must already exist in the account.

products.support_details: This product is in the community registry, as such support is handled through the originated repo. If you experience issues, please open an issue in the repository [here](https://github.com/terraform-ibm-modules/terraform-ibm-redhat-ai-inference/issues). Please note this product is not supported via the IBM Cloud Support Center.

flavors.label: Fully configurable
flavors.name: fully-configurable
flavors.short_description: Deploys a Red Hat AI Inference project in us-east in an existing resource group, or reads an existing project, and optionally checks which inference models are available.

value_constraints.description: Prefix must begin with a lowercase letter and may contain only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens '-'. It must not end with a hyphen('-'), and cannot contain consecutive hyphens ('--'). It should not exceed 16 characters

iam_permissions.notes: Viewer access is required in the resource group you want to provision in.

Platform Editor access is required to create, update and delete the Red Hat AI Inference project. A service access role that allows reading inference models is also required when inference models are listed or checked.
[Optional] Required to attach access management tags to the project.

features.description: Creates a Red Hat AI Inference project, or reads an existing one, and returns its endpoints.
